description: How a Page host starts: a shared-Page check answers from the host record until a request needs the document, which boots the repo once inside blockConcurrencyWhile; a failed boot resets the object, and a boot whose blockConcurrencyWhile rejected while it ran is abandoned. Runs against worker/page-startup.mjs in worker/page-startup.test.mjs.
